messages.content: Please check the status of my living room light light_living and its brightness property, then turn it on with brightness 70 (device value 70) in warm_white. After that, check the current BTC price in USD and my checking account balance for user_123, then place a buy order for 250.5. Next, get the latest AAPL quote and archive that quote snapshot under the title Trade Quote Archive. Then generate an invoice for 1 of product p_sony_xm5_blk, which is 1 Sony XM5 black, using the SAVE15 coupon and PayPal, and send it to alice@company.com. Finally, use the invoice message to create a medium-priority app document and alert titled IoT Update and Purchase Summary on the app channel.
